facts.text: Buck cooks for an army, then makes the kids eat it all week
facts.why: No lasagne or cooking-for-an-army scene turned up in the sources opened. The plot has Buck struggling with domestic jobs, such as the washing machine, not cooking in bulk.
facts.fix: Buck bites off more than he can cook, and the kids eat it anyway.

vibe.verdict: Cosy diner look with a John Candy still, but it is built for pie when the film is about pancakes and a few scenes.
missing: Maizy's class story about Buck microwaving the socks
Buck standing up for Maizy against the assistant principal
Buck locking Bug in the car trunk
Pooter the Clown being punched at the birthday party
ideas: Swap the 'Pie so good it ought to be a crime' tagline for the pancake line 'Pancakes the size of a hubcap'
Rename 'Buck's family-size beef lasagne' to 'Microwaved sock stew' with a Maizy note
Replace the 'Fresh-squeezed orange juice' note with the trunk talk with Bug
